novel_mechanics_found: Level 6 glyph identities were disambiguated from action outcomes: the narrow dark-red glyph is the player, cyan blocks are one-use gravity switches, and the orange outlined block remains an unexplained likely target. A safe descent requires solidifying the two lower X blocks, moving the player three columns right to align over that shelf, flipping the first cyan switch, walking right across and off the shelf into the hazard-free right shaft, then walking left until the second cyan switch blocks passage. Clicking that second switch reverses gravity and leaves the player protected beneath a partition; attempted left movement is blocked, while stepping right out of the notch is lethal.
narrative: The 164-action banked prefix reached frame.levels_completed == 5 on each of three fresh live environments. Two level-6 trials were made. The first died after correctly solidifying the lower X pair because I initially mistook the red player for a switch; the second used the corrected identity and safely reached the lower second-switch region, but the remaining apparent exit from the protected notch caused immediate death. With another 164-action restoration unaffordable while preserving the mandatory gate, exploration stopped at level 5. A final fresh reproduce() replay reached level 5 and returned reproduced=true; total usage was 676 env.step calls.
gotchas: The dark-red narrow glyph is the player; the cyan square is a gravity switch. Clicking the player's location wastes a gravity tick and can be fatal.
At level 6, solidify both lower X blocks and move right three times before clicking the first cyan switch; flipping gravity while still aligned with a pillar column is lethal.
After landing on the two-block shelf, leave from its right edge. Leaving from its left edge was already known to be lethal, while the right shaft safely reaches a lower region.
The second cyan switch is a solid blocker under downward gravity. Approach it from the right, then click it to reverse upward.
After the second switch, repeated left moves are blocked by a white partition. A right move out of the protected notch causes immediate death, apparently from an overhead hazard.
A fresh level-6 attempt costs the full 164-action game prefix; reserve at least another 164 calls for the reproduction gate.
